xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2760: fix(dashboard): make crew create and delete discoverable in Tiered Execution settings

plan.title: fix(dashboard): make crew create and delete discoverable in Tiered Execution settings
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: Crew create/update/delete exist in Settings → Tiered Execution but are unfindable: create hides as '+ new crew…' at the bottom of each board dropdown, delete lives inside the expanded CrewRow and can never succeed on a saved crew (every persisted crew owns ≥1 difficulty and the button refuses while any is owned). The empty state teaches the create trick in prose. Inherited from the approved PAN-2684 mockup, which is the spec and currently encodes the bug.
narratives.Proposal: Operator-approved via interactive mockup (drafts/pan-2760-mockup.html on overdeck-state): (1) '+ Add crew' beside the roster header opens an inline difficulty prompt and reuses the board's create-and-assign path, so a crew never exists without a difficulty and nothing can silently vanish on save; (2) '× remove' on every collapsed row opens a hand-off prompt that reassigns the crew's difficulties to a chosen heir and removes the crew in one write; guards (kind-override, final-difficulty, new last-crew) preserved; (3) hover/focus 'edit' cue makes rows read as expandable; (4) board '+ new crew…' stays; (5) mockup committed to docs/design/mockups/ with a supersession note in the PAN-2684 mockup; (6) docs/TIERED-EXECUTION.md describes the affordances. Full implementation detail in drafts/pan-2760.md (decisions D1-D7, work items W1-W4).
narratives.NonGoals:
- No pan crew CLI verb and no crew-scoped API; crews stay inside the whole-settings blob (GET/PUT /api/settings)
- No changes to tiered-crews.ts serialization/import semantics, tier-name derivation, or the YAML schema
- No draft/unassigned-crew state (option 2 rejected in planning); serializeCrews' zero-difficulty drop stays unreachable by construction
- No changes to supervisor, kind-override add controls, commit feed, escalation, or replay surfaces
- No rework of the PAN-2684 mockup's interactive JS beyond the one-line supersession note

items.title: Add '+ Add crew' roster button with inline difficulty prompt and empty-state create

expected_outputs: TieredExecutionSection.test.tsx passes including new cases for roster-prompt create, empty-state first-crew-owns-all, and disabled kind-routed final difficulty

narrative.Action: Per PRD W1 (drafts/pan-2760.md): extract handleAssignment's 'new' branch (TieredExecutionSection.tsx:183-189) into createCrew(difficulty|null) and the final-difficulty guard (lines 171-177) into finalDifficultyGuard(difficulty). Add addCrewPromptOpen state. Roster header (lines 364-367): shorten hint to 'new crews start on Haiku 4.5, never a frontier model' and add a right-aligned '+ Add crew' button (only when crews.length > 0). When open, render an inline prompt between header and rows: 'The new crew starts on Haiku 4.5. Which difficulty does it take over?' with one button per difficulty (subtext: current owner's crewLabel or 'unassigned'; disabled with the existing guard message when finalDifficultyGuard(difficulty) is non-null) plus cancel. Replace the empty state (lines 380-384) with 'No crews yet — every difficulty needs one before tiered execution can route work.' + '+ Add crew' button calling createCrew(null) + subtext 'Your first crew takes every difficulty; reassign on the board afterwards.' Keep setOpenCrewId(deriveTierName(...)) inside createCrew (hazard H4). Do not modify tiered-crews.ts (hazard H1).

items.title: Given tiered execution with at least one crew, when the operator clicks '+ Add crew' beside the roster header and picks a difficulty in the prompt, the UI creates a crew with model claude-haiku-4-5, assigns that difficulty to it, and renders its row expanded — without any board dropdown being opened

Given zero crews, the empty state renders an '+ Add crew' button that creates a first crew owning all five difficulties with no difficulty prompt, and the old 'Choose "+ new crew…" on the board' prose no longer renders
In the difficulty prompt, a difficulty that is the final difficulty of a kind-routed crew renders disabled and shows the existing final-difficulty guard message
The board's '+ new crew…' option still creates and assigns a crew in one gesture — the existing board-create test continues to pass unchanged
The 'frontier models are never the default' test still passes and createCrew reuses DEFAULT_MODEL with no new model literal introduced
Collapsed-row '× remove' with heir hand-off flow and expandability cue

expected_outputs: TieredExecutionSection.test.tsx passes including the rewritten hand-off remove test, kind-override guard test, last-crew guard test, and no-toggle-on-remove-click test

narrative.Action: Per PRD W2 (drafts/pan-2760.md): TieredExecutionSection owns removePromptCrewId and removeError state plus handleRequestRemove(crewId) (kind overrides → existing message 'Move or remove these kind overrides before removing this crew.'; sole crew → 'This is the only crew, and every difficulty needs one. Add another crew first — or turn tiered execution off.'; owns difficulties → open heir prompt; owns nothing → remove directly) and handleRemoveWithHeir(crewId, heirId) (reassign each owned difficulty to heir, filter the crew, single writeCrews call). CrewRow: replace onRemove prop with onRequestRemove, delete local removeError state and guard logic (lines 75-79), expanded-body Remove button calls onRequestRemove; add '× remove' button to the collapsed summary (aria-label 'Remove crew <label>', stopPropagation + preventDefault so the row does not toggle — hazard H3); add hover/focus highlight and an 'edit' cue next to the caret (hidden until hover/focus, Tailwind group pattern). Render the error text and the heir prompt ('Removing <label> — give <difficulties> to:' + one button per other crew with blended cost + cancel) as siblings directly beneath the owning row. Rewrite the superseded dead-end-remove test at line 162 (hazard H2); keep line 201's kind-override-only semantics.

items.title: A collapsed crew row renders an accessible 'Remove crew <label>' control; clicking it on a crew owning difficulties opens an inline hand-off prompt listing every other crew, and choosing an heir emits a single onSettingsChange whose config no longer contains the crew and has its difficulties owned by the heir
Clicking × remove on a crew holding kind overrides renders 'Move or remove these kind overrides before removing this crew.' and emits no settings change
Clicking × remove when only one crew exists renders a message that every difficulty needs a crew and emits no settings change

Clicking × remove does not toggle the row open/closed, and the Remove crew button inside the expanded body routes through the same hand-off flow (the old 'Assign these difficulties to another crew before removing it.' dead-end no longer renders anywhere)
Hovering or focusing a collapsed row applies a visible background highlight and reveals an 'edit' cue next to the caret
Commit approved PAN-2760 mockup and add supersession note to the PAN-2684 mockup
